records.title: Chagatai I
records.text: CHGTAI 401 Chagatai I (5) A&H Expansion of reading skills learned in intermediate Turkic languages and introduction of the basic Chagatai Arabic orthographic conventions and linguistic characteristics of textual sources. Develops skills necessary for fluent manuscript reading and comprehending Chagatai primary texts written in Islamic Central Asia from the fifteenth to the early twentieth centuries. Prerequisite: either TKIC 405, TKIC 423, TKIC 429, KAZAKH 205, UYGUR 203, or UZBEK 203.
